player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Níor aimsíodh formáid glaoch bailí. Úsáid [a1b2], m.sh. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Níl aon phictiúir ag an dearg. Buaitear dubh!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ní raibh aon phictiúir ag na Dubha. Bhuaigh an dearg!
outcome.no_moves: Níl aon ghluaiseachtaí fágtha ag imreoir {player_id}.
outcome.draw: Tá an teorainn casadh bainte amach.
